chapters.label: Live
chapters.text: Munich, 1974, the World Cup final. West Germany, in white, play the Netherlands, in orange. It's one each, just before half-time. Rainer Bonhof races down the right and passes. Gerd Müller turns and shoots. Goal!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch it again. The pass bounces off Müller, and two defenders close in. No time to think! He spins on the spot and hits it low, early, into the corner. The keeper is wrong-footed.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Müller's goal won the World Cup. In the box, turn quickly and shoot early, before defenders can block it.
